title: Gothic Maids and Red Mailbox
description: Three women in matching blue and black corset outfits with cat ears stand in a dramatic gothic setting. One kneels looking up at the central standing woman while the third holds a cardboard 'FRAGILE' package next to an open red mailbox, surrounded by lit red candles and swirling blue smoke.
prompt: Three beautiful women wearing matching dark blue lace-up corsets and black bottoms with cat ear headbands in a dramatic gothic castle courtyard at dusk. One woman with long blonde braided hair stands centrally, a dark-haired woman kneels before her looking up adoringly, while a smiling blonde woman on the right holds a cardboard fragile package next to an open bright red mailbox. Lit red candles on the stone ground, swirling blue smoke, dark castle with red fence in background, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
